summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark, including improvements for small file workloads and variant type support. Proposals have been made to enhance the REST specification, including adding relative paths and clarifying identifier uniqueness across catalog object types.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on adding an 'Attributes' field to Iceberg V4
Clarification of identifier uniqueness in REST Spec
